The '''1963&ndash;64 season''' was the 65th season for '''[[FC Barcelona]]'''.

The team toured South America and Mexico in the summer of 1964.<ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.sport.es/es/noticias/barca/accidentada-gira-1964-105498814|title=La accidentada gira de 1964|first=David|last=Salinas|work=[[Sport (Spanish newspaper)|Sport]]|date=13 July 2024|access-date=22 November 2024|language=es}}</ref>
